protocol.design_status: Written before the present numerical study outcomes. Informed methodological development uses the existing synthetic hedging study and known earlier numerical findings; not untouched preregistration.
protocol.data: Synthetic constant-coefficient GBM only. Existing exact binary64 contract primitives; exact rational drift interval centres, half widths and budgets.
protocol.known_volatility_scope: One known common volatility under P and Q. Risk-neutral fair prices stay fixed as the physical total-return drift varies.
protocol.robust_method: Rational grid proposals, outward node risk and finite-mixture weak-duality lower bound, with Gaussian-Holder cell inflation for a continuous-drift upper bound. Tests are not the proof of that bound.
protocol.finite_grid_reference: Independent piecewise truncated-lognormal moment coefficients. SciPy epigraph proposals are refined at 160 digits by their active-set KKT equations. Numerical diagnostics only; exact feasibility and optimality claims come from interval certificates.
comparators: same-budget oracle hedge at the known synthetic true drift 0.03
protocol.comparison_scope: Compare worst risk over the same dense diagnostic drift grid and risk at true drift 0.03. Retain every adverse ranking. Robustness does not imply smaller risk at each drift, nor improved empirical performance.

confidence_diagnostics.scope: Exact Gaussian pivot with known volatility, numerical quantile witnesses and rounding inclusion. Finite synthetic containment counts are diagnostics, not a demonstration of nominal coverage. No raw simulated increments retained.

protocol.guards: Fresh external output directory; preserve source hashes before/after; retain failures and unresolved records; exit nonzero on missing cases, failed checks or source changes. No change to existing study files.
